# create/save reusable transform based on separator marker grids
open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # separator rows/columns are the recurring rows/columns without tile background
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if bg not in row]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    nr=max(1,len(rs)-1); nc=max(1,len(cs)-1)
    out=[[bg]*nc for _ in range(nr)]
    for i,r in enumerate(rs[:-1]):
      for j,c in enumerate(cs[:-1]):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v!=0 and v!=bg: out[i][j]=v
    return out
''')
